issue.body:
<!-- C271-P02-CURRENT:START -->
## C271 P02 — blocked validation (2026-11-20)

The required routine driver completed with exit 1: the unit suite exceeded 900 seconds without a completion footer, and isolated documentation failed on 21 links to five tracked instruction files omitted by the driver copy. Five other routine stages passed. The complete affected cohort passed all 12 checks and 282 methods without failures, errors or skips.

Independent review does **not** approve integration or parent closure. C271 is blocked/open; R01/R02 remain done, R03–R05 remain unmet, and P02 remains in progress. This PR remains draft and its branch remains unmerged. Main is unchanged at `e1a48f7d0635e9aa4f4b6d6a586e7305eb81999d`; no integration lease or repair was attempted.

[Published phase outcome](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/70a658c31085bf8dd78d79663c57f8e3cdb28ceb/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/finalization-20261120/PHASE-OUTCOME.json) · [Validation report](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/70a658c31085bf8dd78d79663c57f8e3cdb28ceb/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/finalization-20261120/verification/REPORT.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/70a658c31085bf8dd78d79663c57f8e3cdb28ceb/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/finalization-20261120/independent-review/REPORT.md)

Fresh full-checkout workflow/documentation checks passed on that clean published source. The verified partial handoff and two matching prompts are being prepared; their separate saved receipt will follow. Saving this phase does not complete the parent task.

First remaining action, in a fresh bounded phase: repair the five-file copy omission with focused validation-tool coverage, prepare declared dependencies, and establish a justified completion plan for the full required routine driver. Preserve all failed evidence, tests, controls and per-source resource limits; obtain independent acceptance before integration.
<!-- C271-P02-CURRENT:END -->

## Earlier phase records (retained history)

## C271 P02 in progress

The fresh continuation phase has confirmed its early recovery ZIP and resumed required R03 verification on the retained candidate. Director: `c271-p02-c219bb61a617`. [Phase checkpoint](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/commit/2a85f71489fea57dc165cde61e3f7cc67a8ae999). Required routine-driver and complete affected-cohort outcomes, plus independent integration eligibility review, remain pending. Preparation limitations are recorded without waiver. Main remains `e1a48f7d0635e9aa4f4b6d6a586e7305eb81999d`; no main lease or integration. PR stays draft and parent stays open. The phase stops after eligible integration/final delivery or an honest saved partial handoff at a concrete blocker.

## Preserved P01 scope and delivery

**Current status: P01 delivered; parent remains open.** R01/R02 and the planned P01 partial save are complete. R03–R05/P02 remain open. In a fresh parent chat, resume the retained branch and draft [PR274](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/274) at required R03 integration verification.

## Purpose

The C269 coverage audit left H22.02 partial because no isolated removal of the actual source import digest and retained outcome was demonstrated. C270 is complete. The owner's fresh continuation request authorizes one next bounded step under PROTOCOL section 8.

## Current phase

Prepare, execute and independently review the isolated H22.02 control candidate on `work/c271-missing-import-digest-control`, starting from main `e1a48f7d0635e9aa4f4b6d6a586e7305eb81999d`. Freeze independent source mutations and exact expectations before observation. Preserve original source/artifact bytes, every result and existing failures. Publish a recoverable candidate and verified partial handoff, then stop.

This phase does not merge or change observer/runtime behavior, contracts, pins, other H groups, source evaluation or native/model trials. The parent remains open for integration checks and final delivery.

## Ownership and gates

Director: `c271-control-cce28e2b3ca4`. Root owns Git/index, canonical records and publication; real independent workers own fixture and review reports. No main integration lease is held. Requirements R01-R05 and two phase boundaries are in `docs/workflow/tasks/C271/` at scope commit `c27609ebab7c86ff20d7bd288994b49e3dd3c7e1`.

Before later integration: complete the required routine local driver, full affected regression inventory, independent integration review, expected-head ownership/update, fresh actual-main checks and branch lifecycle. Close only after all parent gates and final saved delivery pass.

## Recovery

Early recovery save confirmed: `OntoKin_C271_Control_Early_Recovery_2026-11-20.zip`, 11,365,488 bytes, SHA-256 `159769f7cce5de2364ccb0a8c3e49f7275233f370ad3102d6d7e975a05a3b727`. Separate receipt will be published on the scope branch. No hosted CI or paid execution requested.

## Confirmed P01 delivery checkpoint

Six input cases produced 18 expected interface outcomes: six baseline successes and twelve exact `MALFORMED` refusals. Focused independent review, clean workflow/documentation checks and independent archive verification passed. The command-provenance review finding and archive-checker first attempts remain preserved.

Verified [partial handoff ZIP](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-6fa4862a8b2c8191957e4b0760c32705_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) and both matching prompts are saved. Exact identities and checks: [separate P01 receipt](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/88bc8b51b3963b7072375edac6400b6e6a4532e4/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/delivery/P01-DELIVERY.json). Candidate freeze `e0b73f7d6ce49631e598d1378a0ddba717726524`; later receipt-only publication `88bc8b51b3963b7072375edac6400b6e6a4532e4`. P01 is done; parent is in progress. Main remains `e1a48f7d0635e9aa4f4b6d6a586e7305eb81999d`; no merge or main lease. The original phase declaration above is retained as history.
